description: Build the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts and the consolidated catalytic-site comparison figure
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------- artifact 1: evidence matrix ----------------
ev=[
 dict(citation="PMID:28003339", evidence_type="interaction / mutant construct (Y2H + deletion mapping)",
      stance="qualifies (supports the binding-module alternative)",
      claim_tested="What does the LRGUK1 GUK-like region do",
      key_finding="The GUK-like domain is required for binding HOOK2 and RIMBP3; the LRR domain is required for KLC3",
      context="Mouse, adult testis Y2H library, haploid male germ cells",
      confidence="High for binding; gives no information on catalysis, which was never assayed"),
 dict(citation="PMID:25781171", evidence_type="mutant phenotype / localization",
      stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="Is LRGUK-1 required for sperm assembly",
      key_finding="Lrguk1 loss gives oligoasthenoteratospermia: basal body attachment, sub-distal appendage, axoneme extension and manchette defects",
      context="Mouse, ENU/knockout male germ line",
      confidence="High for the phenotype; all of it is downstream of the molecular function and none of it requires kinase activity"),
 dict(citation="PMID:22117215", evidence_type="structural (crystal) + binding assay",
      stance="competing / qualifies",
      claim_tested="What the GMP pocket of an inactive GUK domain is used for",
      key_finding="In DLG1 the GMP-binding site has evolved into a specific pSer/pThr-binding pocket; other MAGUK GKs also bind phospho-peptides",
      context="Human DLG1 SH3-GK with phospho-LGN peptide",
      confidence="High; supplies the alternative model that this analysis tests and partly excludes for LRGUK"),
 dict(citation="PMID:21965684", evidence_type="structural (crystal) / review-level statement",
      stance="supports (defines the inactive reference class)",
      claim_tested="Are MAGUK GUK domains catalytically active",
      key_finding="MAGUK core is a PDZ-SH3-GuK tandem in which the GuK domain is catalytically inactive",
      context="Human ZO-1 PDZ3-SH3-GuK",
      confidence="High for the class statement"),
 dict(citation="PMID:32296183", evidence_type="interaction (AP-MS, BioPlex)",
      stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="Does human LRGUK interact with HOOK2",
      key_finding="Source of the only human GO:0005515 annotation on Q96M69, with UniProtKB:Q96ED9-2 (HOOK2 isoform 2)",
      context="Human HEK293T/HCT116 AP-MS",
      confidence="Medium; high-throughput, but it reproduces the mouse Y2H partner in human cells"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt Q16774/P15454/Q96M69, Pfam PF00625, InterPro IPR008144)",
      evidence_type="computational: Smith-Waterman BLOSUM62 alignment, catalytic-residue scoring",
      stance="supports",
      claim_tested="Does LRGUK retain the GK catalytic residues",
      key_finding="Walker A is GPEACGK-R428, the Mg2+ Ser/Thr is lost; GMP pocket 5/11; catalytic Arg 0/3 (R44->Y454, R137->K547, R148->A558). Yeast GK control scores 8/9, 9/11, 3/3",
      context="Sequence analysis, human and yeast reference enzymes, 4 human MAGUK GK domains",
      confidence="High for residue identity; residue loss predicts but does not prove loss of activity"),
 dict(citation="This work (93 UniProt LRGUK orthologs; 12-species deep sample)",
      evidence_type="evolutionary",
      stance="supports",
      claim_tested="Is the degeneracy ancestral or a human-specific artefact",
      key_finding="0/93 orthologs have Ser or Thr at Walker A +1; 92/93 have Arg. In 12 species from elephant shark to human the catalytic Arg44 equivalent is Tyr 12/12 and the Asp103 equivalent is never Asp",
      context="Vertebrates, Chondrichthyes to Mammalia",
      confidence="High; fixed over >450 Myr. Limitation: many entries are automatic gene-model predictions"),
 dict(citation="This work (AF-Q96M69-F1 v6, AF-Q16774-F1 v6, PDB 1LVG, phenix.superpose_pdbs)",
      evidence_type="structural / computational",
      stance="supports",
      claim_tested="Is the GK fold intact and are the nucleotide sites usable",
      key_finding="GUK-like domain superposes on GMP+ADP-bound mouse GK at 1.33 A over 160 CA; 11 heavy atoms within 2.5 A of GMP and 21 within 2.5 A of ADP (min 0.32 and 0.75 A) against 2 and 1 for the AlphaFold active-GUK1 control",
      context="Predicted human LRGUK model vs experimental mouse GK ternary complex",
      confidence="Medium-high. Caveat: GK is a hinged enzyme and AlphaFold gives one apo-like state, so occlusion is an argument, not a binding measurement"),
 dict(citation="UniProt Q96M69 (ECO:0000255, PROSITE-ProRule PRU00100); QuickGO",
      evidence_type="database",
      stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="What nucleotide-related annotation exists today",
      key_finding="'Binding site 421-428 ATP' is rule-propagated with no experimental support; no EC number, no CATALYTIC ACTIVITY comment; neither GO:0004385 nor GO:0005524 is annotated in human or mouse",
      context="Database records retrieved 2026-11-23",
      confidence="High; defines the curation baseline"),
 dict(citation="This work (25 reviewed human PF00625 proteins; pSer-pocket residues)",
      evidence_type="computational / comparative",
      stance="qualifies (narrows the hypothesis)",
      claim_tested="Is LRGUK simply a MAGUK-like GUK domain",
      key_finding="All 5 MAGUK GK domains keep 2/2 basic residues at the phosphate-gripping R41/R44 positions and Thr at position 83; LRGUK keeps 1/2 (R451, with R44->Y454) and has Leu493 at position 83",
      context="Human MPP1, DLG1, DLG4, CASK vs LRGUK",
      confidence="Medium-high; predicts LRGUK is not a canonical MAGUK-type pSer reader either"),
]
edf=pd.DataFrame(ev); edf.to_csv("out/evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("evidence_matrix.csv rows:",len(edf))

# ---------------- artifact 2: GO decision table ----------------
go=[
 dict(go_id="GO:0004385", label="guanylate kinase activity", aspect="MF",
      current_status="not annotated (human Q96M69 or mouse Q9D5S7)",
      recommended_action="do not add; record as explicitly excluded",
      basis="0/3 catalytic Arg, no Mg2+ Ser/Thr, GMP pocket 5/11, both sites occluded, fixed across 93 orthologs"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005524", label="ATP binding", aspect="MF",
      current_status="not annotated in GO; present in UniProt only as PRU00100 feature 421-428",
      recommended_action="do not add; flag the UniProt feature as rule-propagated and not transferable",
      basis="Walker A +1 Ser/Thr absent in 0/93 orthologs; 21 LRGUK atoms occupy the ADP site in superposition"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0019901 / GO:0019904", label="protein kinase binding / protein domain specific binding", aspect="MF",
      current_status="not annotated",
      recommended_action="not supported by current data; do not add",
      basis="No evidence that HOOK2 or RIMBP3 binding is to a kinase or a defined domain class"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005515", label="protein binding", aspect="MF",
      current_status="annotated, IPI, PMID:32296183 with HOOK2 isoform 2",
      recommended_action="retain but do not leave as the final MF statement; prefer a complex/BP term plus the domain-mapped interaction",
      basis="PMID 28003339 maps HOOK2 and RIMBP3 binding specifically to the GUK-like domain"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0002177", label="manchette", aspect="CC",
      current_status="annotated ISS in human from mouse Q9D5S7; IDA in mouse (PMID:25781171)",
      recommended_action="retain",
      basis="Direct mouse localization; the GUK-like domain binds manchette cargo adaptors"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0035082", label="axoneme assembly", aspect="BP",
      current_status="annotated ISS/IBA in human; IDA/IMP in mouse",
      recommended_action="retain as core BP",
      basis="Mouse knockout phenotype, PMID:25781171"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0032991 / GO:0120293", label="protein-containing complex / dynein axonemal particle (consider)", aspect="CC",
      current_status="not annotated",
      recommended_action="curator lead only; verify before use",
      basis="PMID 28003339 describes a multiprotein complex with HOOK1-3, RIMBP3 and KLC3, but does not define a named GO complex"),
]
gdf=pd.DataFrame(go); gdf.to_csv("out/go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("go_decision_table.csv rows:",len(gdf))

# ---------------- summary figure ----------------
sites=["P-loop\nWalker A\n(9 pos)","GMP pocket\n(11 pos)","Catalytic Arg\n(3 pos)","pSer-reader\nR41/R44\n(2 pos)"]
yeast=[8/9,9/11,3/3,2/2]; lrguk=[4/9,5/11,0/3,1/2]
maguk=[np.mean([3/9,3/9,3/9,5/9]), 7/11, np.mean([1/3,2/3,1/3,1/3]), 2/2]
x=np.arange(4); w=0.26
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5))
ax.bar(x-w,[100*v for v in yeast],w,color="#2e7d5b",label="yeast GUK1 (active enzyme)")
ax.bar(x,   [100*v for v in maguk],w,color="#3b6ea5",label="MAGUK GK domains (mean of MPP1, DLG1, PSD-95, CASK)")
ax.bar(x+w,[100*v for v in lrguk],w,color="#d94a3d",label="LRGUK GUK-like domain")
for xi,(a,b,c) in enumerate(zip(yeast,maguk,lrguk)):
    for dx,v in ((-w,a),(0,b),(w,c)): ax.text(xi+dx,100*v+2,f"{100*v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(sites,fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("% of reference positions identical to human GUK1",fontsize=11); ax.set_ylim(0,115)
ax.set_title("LRGUK is degenerate at every catalytic site class, and is degenerate where the MAGUKs are not\n"
             "(reference: human GUK1 Q16774 catalytic and ligand-binding positions)",fontsize=12,loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=9,frameon=False,loc="upper right")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
print(pd.DataFrame({"site":[s.replace("\n"," ") for s in sites],
                    "yeast_GK_%":[round(100*v,1) for v in yeast],
                    "MAGUK_mean_%":[round(100*v,1) for v in maguk],
                    "LRGUK_%":[round(100*v,1) for v in lrguk]}).to_string(index=False))
